args.description: 2D side-view beat 'em up stage background, Streets of Rage 2 pixel art, flat orthographic side view, same art style, palette and lighting as the style image (warm late afternoon). Top 62% of the image: building ground floor facade. Bottom 38%: the same wide empty grey paved sidewalk of large square concrete tiles seen slightly from above, the wall meets the floor at 63% of the image height, clean open floor, no people. An archway: a wide dark arched passage through the residential building in the center, through the arch a glimpse of a bright inner courtyard; on both sides of the arch small shop fronts in the ground floor with glass display windows and blank light signboards above them: a grocery shop with fruit in the window, a pharmacy with a green cross, a flower shop with buckets of flowers by the door. Cream-beige tile facade with protruding bays above.
